summary: Tax exemption under Package Scheme of Incentives 1993; validity post-amendment of Section 8(5) of CST Act by Finance Act 2002; retrospective application; exemption upheld despite failure to submit Form C/D; power of State to grant exemption under Section 8(5) prior to amendment; impugned circulars and notices quashed; High Court judgment affirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of High Court upheld; tax exemption maintained; revision notices and circulars quashed.
